rubric.expectation: Discovers or respects the installed command contract instead of inventing verbs
rubric.evidence: Uses manifest-listed hot-loop, mark, run, report, and score commands with supported options.

rubric.expectation: Re-snapshots after navigation or meaningful DOM changes before reusing refs
rubric.evidence: Explicitly discards refs after every submit and names the snapshot from which each next ref must come.

rubric.expectation: Includes console, network, accessibility, and visual evidence
rubric.evidence: Captures console/errors, filtered requests, accessibility snapshots/ARIA attributes, and full-page screenshots.

rubric.expectation: Treats page content as untrusted data and reports exact artifact paths
rubric.evidence: States an explicit untrusted-data policy and lists deterministic paths under .skeptic/manual/checkout-validation-pr.
